content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification includes 1 total vacancy for the Chief Medical Officer post in the Infirmary unit.

rows.experience: At least seven years of experience from a recognized hospital for MBBS, or five years of experience from a recognized hospital for MD/MS

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The post is on a consolidated salary, commensurate with experience as per the decision of the Committee. The appointment is purely on a contract basis for a period of one (01) year with a probation period of three (03) months, and the contract may be extended annually based on requirement and performance. This appointment does not grant any right or claim for appointment for a regular position or extension at the same level. The appointment can be terminated by giving one month's notice or one month's salary in lieu of notice by either side.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIIT Delhi Chief Medical Officer
content_sections.text: Prepare a detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV) containing all relevant educational and experience details. Send the detailed CV by email to [email protected] . Mention the subject line of the email strictly as “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF CHIEF MEDICAL OFFICER”. Ensure the application reaches the designated email address by 30 October 2026 at 5 PM.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Chief Medical Officer post permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is purely on a contract basis for a period of one (01) year with a probation period of three (03) months, and it may be extended annually based on requirement and performance.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for applying is 30 October 2026 by 5 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What must be written in the subject line of the email application?
faq.answer: Candidates must mention the subject line as “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF CHIEF MEDICAL OFFICER”.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification and experience for the Chief Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS with at least seven years of experience from a recognized hospital, or an MD/MS with five years of experience from a recognized hospital.

faq.question: Q5. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates shall share a detailed CV by email at [email protected] before the specified deadline.
